Route27FisherText:
Do you know what
you just did?

You've taken your
first step into KANTO.

Check your #-
GEAR MAP and see.
CooltrainermBlakeSeenText:
You look pretty
strong. Let me battle you!
CooltrainermBlakeAfterBattleText:
If you prevail on
this harsh trek,

the truth will be
revealed!

Heh, sorry, I just
wanted to say something cool.
CooltrainermBrianAfterBattleText:
A good trainer can
recognize other good trainers.
CooltrainerfReenaSeenText:
You shouldn't
underestimate the

wild #MON in
these parts.
CooltrainerfReenaAfterBattleText:
You're just a kid,
but you're not to

be underestimated
either.
CooltrainerfMeganSeenText:
It's rare to see
anyone come here.

Are you training
on your own?
CooltrainerfMeganAfterBattleText:
I'm checking out
pre- and post- evolution #MON.

Evolution really
does make #MON stronger.

But evolved forms
also learn moves later on.
PsychicGilbertSeenText:
Don't say a thing!

Let me guess what
you're thinking.

Mmmmmmm…

I got it! You're
on the #MON LEAGUE challenge!
PsychicGilbertAfterBattleText:
With your skills,
you'll do well at the LEAGUE.

That's what my
premonition says.
BirdKeeperJose2AfterBattleText:
BIRD KEEPERS like
me mimic bird

whistles to com-
mand #MON.
TohjoFallsSignText:
TOHJO FALLS

THE LINK BETWEEN
KANTO AND JOHTO
